title: Python streaming chat graceful-reconnect adapter and developer guide
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Add a compact, batteries-included "graceful reconnect" adapter to the Python SDK to simplify handling transient stream interruptions, reconnection logic, idempotent event replay, and developer ergonomics for event-driven chat completions.
implementation_notes: Design an adapter that wraps the existing async iterator/generator streaming surface and exposes: (1) resumable checkpoints (byte/fragment offsets + server watermark), (2) idempotent delivery semantics, (3) configurable backoff/backpressure policy, (4) hooks for telemetry (span creation, token-level counters), and (5) a synchronous-friendly facade. Implementation will be split into core adapter, small public API surface, tests (unit + integration with staging runtime), and examples in docs/examples/streaming/graceful_reconnect.md.
acceptance_criteria: SDK exposes `ReconnectStream` helper that can wrap any streaming chat completion async iterator
"ReconnectStream" supports opaque checkpoints that can be serialized and used to resume without duplicating final user-visible content
Default reconnection policy uses jittered exponential backoff with max 30s and attempts configurable by caller
Adapter integrates with our telemetry hooks: emits start/resume/abort spans and token emission counters
Comprehensive unit tests cover: abort during payload assemble, repeated reconnects, and idempotent replays
Integration test against runtime staging verifies resume semantics for partial KV cache resets and model-variant fallbacks
Docs include two minimal patterns: async-iterator example and sync-callback adapter for simple apps
tasks: Draft API proposal and example snippets for async and sync consumers
Wire telemetry events and add trace metadata
Add retry/backoff configuration knobs and validation
Write unit tests for edge cases (duplicate event filtering, non-monotonic offsets)
Create integration test harness that injects network failures and server-side idempotency markers
Author developer guide and example notebooks
PR review and address feedback from SDK/Runtime teams
updates: 2026-03-01: Ticket created. Initial proposal drafted by Ava. Goal is to reduce engineering burden for apps that need long-lived chat streams with network flakiness.
2026-03-04: Design review with runtime team. Decided to keep checkpoint opaque (string blob) to avoid coupling to server ABI. Runtime will emit a resume_token in stream sideband events.
2026-03-07: Spike implemented: proof-of-concept adapter that resumes from opaque resume_token and deduplicates final chunks. POC located in feature/spike/reconnect-adapter branch.
2026-03-10: Telemetry schema proposed: `stream.reconnect` span with attributes: attempts, last_offset, resume_token, reason. Added to design doc for review.
2026-03-12: QA ran integration tests with injected TCP resets. Observed duplication for partial token boundary cases; adjusted dedupe logic to be boundary-aware.

2026-03-14: Working on public API ergonomics. Two variant shapes under consideration: a lightweight `with ReconnectStream(...) as stream:` context manager and an explicit `ReconnectStream.wrap(async_iterable)` factory. Aligning on both to support sync and async usage patterns.
